entities.summary: Theodosii Spassov (b. 1961-03-04, Isperih) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Isperih and Bulgaria. Known in the fields of bulgaria, composers & musicians, europe.
